title: Laravel
label: Laravel
desc: A full-stack PHP framework for routing, database work, authentication and background queues.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the framework, prepare a local database and start the development server:

snippets.code:
# Scaffold a project with Composer
composer create-project laravel/laravel inventory
cd inventory

# The default connection is SQLite; make sure the file exists
touch database/database.sqlite
php artisan migrate

# Serve the app on http://127.0.0.1:8000
php artisan serve

# Overview of versions, drivers and environment
php artisan about

# Every registered route with method, URI and action
php artisan route:list

# Rebuild the cached config after editing .env
php artisan config:clear

sections.title: Routing
sections.description: Declare URLs in routes/web.php, with parameters, names and groups:

snippets.code:
<?php

use App\Http\Controllers\Admin\DashboardController;
use App\Http\Controllers\ProductController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

// Closure route with a required segment
Route::get('/hello/{name}', fn (string $name) => "Hello {$name}");

// Numeric constraint plus a name used by route('products.show', 42)
Route::get('/products/{product}', [ProductController::class, 'show'])
    ->whereNumber('product')
    ->name('products.show');

// Shared prefix, name prefix and middleware
Route::middleware('auth')->prefix('admin')->name('admin.')->group(function () {
    Route::get('/dashboard', [DashboardController::class, 'index'])->name('dashboard');
});

sections.title: Controllers
sections.description: Group request handling; generate one with Artisan and inject dependencies:

snippets.code:
# Resource controller with all seven actions
php artisan make:controller ProductController --resource --model=Product

# API controller without create/edit views
php artisan make:controller Api/ProductController --api

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        return view('products.index', [
            'products' => Product::query()->latest()->paginate(15),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $product = Product::create($request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'price_cents' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0'],
        ]));

        return redirect()->route('products.show', $product);
    }
}

sections.title: Models
sections.description: Each table gets a model class that maps columns to PHP attributes:

snippets.code:
# Model plus migration, factory and seeder
php artisan make:model Product -mfs

# Wiring for an existing table, keeping the generated files
php artisan make:model Category -mf

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Product extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    // Columns allowed in mass assignment
    protected $fillable = ['name', 'slug', 'price_cents', 'published_at'];

    // Keep PHP types stable when reading rows
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'price_cents' => 'integer',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'published_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }
}

sections.title: Migrations
sections.description: Version the schema in PHP so every environment can rebuild it:

snippets.code:
# Create a migration for a new table or an existing one
php artisan make:migration create_products_table
php artisan make:migration add_sku_to_products_table --table=products

# Apply and undo
php artisan migrate
php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1

<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        Schema::create('products', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name', 120);
            $table->string('slug', 140)->unique();
            $table->unsignedInteger('price_cents');
            $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true);
            $table->foreignId('category_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();
            $table->timestamps();
            $table->index(['is_active', 'created_at']);
        });
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        Schema::dropIfExists('products');
    }
};

sections.title: Eloquent
sections.description: Query through models instead of hand-written SQL:

sections.title: Relationships
sections.description: Describe links between models and let Eloquent join the rows:

snippets.code:
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Category extends Model
{
    public function products(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Product::class);
    }
}

class Product extends Model
{
    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class);
    }

    public function tags(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Tag::class)->withTimestamps();
    }
}

sections.title: Validation
sections.description: Validate in a form request, then consume only the checked data:

snippets.code:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class StoreProductRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return $this->user()->can('create', Product::class);
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'slug' => ['required', 'alpha_dash', Rule::unique('products', 'slug')],
            'price_cents' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0'],
            'category_id' => ['required', 'exists:categories,id'],
            'published_at' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after:today'],
        ];
    }
}

sections.title: Middleware
sections.description: Wrap a request before it reaches the route, or a response on the way out:

snippets.code:
# Generate the class in app/Http/Middleware
php artisan make:middleware EnsureTokenIsValid

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureTokenIsValid
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if ($request->header('X-Api-Token') !== config('services.reports.token')) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Invalid token'], 401);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

sections.title: Queues and Jobs
sections.description: Move slow work out of the request into a background worker:

snippets.code:
# Jobs and failed_jobs tables for the database driver
php artisan make:queue-table
php artisan migrate

# Worker: listen to two queues, retry three times, time out at 90s
php artisan queue:work --queue=emails,default --tries=3 --timeout=90

# Inspect and replay failures
php artisan queue:failed
php artisan queue:retry all

<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Mail\InvoiceReady;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;

class SendInvoiceEmail implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public int $tries = 3;
    public int $backoff = 30;

    public function __construct(public Invoice $invoice)
    {
    }

    public function handle(): void
    {
        Mail::to($this->invoice->email)->send(new InvoiceReady($this->invoice));
    }
}

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Feature tests hit the HTTP layer; unit tests target one class:

snippets.code:
# Whole suite, then a single class or method
php artisan test
php artisan test --filter=ProductTest
php artisan test tests/Feature/ProductTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProductTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_guest_is_redirected_to_login(): void
    {
        $this->post('/products', ['name' => 'Desk Lamp'])
            ->assertRedirect('/login');
    }

    public function test_authenticated_user_can_create_a_product(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $this->actingAs($user)
            ->post('/products', ['name' => 'Desk Lamp', 'price_cents' => 4590])
            ->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', ['name' => 'Desk Lamp']);
    }
}
